_note: PrimeTurf turf range. Specs come from the PT product cards. `priceTier` links each product to a band in `priceBands`, which is PrimeTurf's installed price (material, labour, excavation, sub-base and edging) in R/m². The estimator places each project inside its band by site difficulty. `look` picks the colour style used to paint the concept visual. Set `published: true` on an item to also build its /turf/{id}/ page.

priceBands.label: Value & decorative
priceBands.use: Side passages, patios, courtyard borders and budget residential lawns. Hard-wearing for busy walkways.

priceBands.label: Standard
priceBands.use: Everyday gardens, school play areas, estate secondary lawns and balconies.

priceBands.label: Premium
priceBands.use: Front lawns, luxury estate landscaping and pool surrounds. Dense and soft underfoot.

priceBands.label: Sport
priceBands.use: Putting greens, multi-courts and high-impact play surfaces.
